entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For quality and training purposes, this call may be recorded. Please hold while I connect you to an agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I hope you can help. I need to make a return, and I just feel terrible about it.
I'm sorry to hear that, but I can certainly look into the options for you. Could I start with your name and the order number, please?
Of course. It's Anya Sharma, order number 774-29B. It's for a helmet. I've been a loyal customer for a long time and this is the first time I've ever had to call about something like this.
Thank you for that information, Anya. I see the order for the Trail Helmet here. So I can best assist, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. It's just... the color. It looked so different on the website. Now that I have it, it just doesn't feel right. The box is still unopened and everything. I really needed this money for some other expenses, and I was so hoping it wouldn't be a problem.
I completely understand. Getting the right gear is crucial, and your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities. Let me just pull up the policy details for your order. One moment.
Okay, thanks for holding. I see here that the helmet was delivered 65 days ago. Our standard policy allows for returns on items within 90 days of delivery, so you're well within the window.
Oh, really? So I can return it for a full refund? That's such a relief. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it.

Yes, absolutely. Since the box is unopened, we can process a full refund. I am emailing you a prepaid return shipping label right now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any shipping center.
Thank you, thank you so much, Isaac! You've really made my day. I appreciate your help.
You're very welcome, Anya. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great rest of your day, and thanks for being a VeloFit customer.
